|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Once per game, you may ▲ an Immediate Effect. When forfeited from an opponent's starship site, may satisfy all remaining battle damage and attrition against you.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wyron Serper (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Once per game, may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If just forfeited from an opponent’s starship site, may satisfy all remaining attrition and battle damage against you.” '''What changed:''' removed “you”; “▲” → “take”; “Effect. When” → “Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If just”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; added “attrition and”; removed “and attrition”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 24. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Wyron Serper]].
* Later text: [[Wyron Serper (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Wyron Serper (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Wyron Serper]].
